# Proxy legal (public)

Public Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for the Proxy mobile app.

**Source of truth** for edits: `docs/legal/` in the private [proxy](https://github.com/PhantomOrganization/proxy) app repo. HTML here is generated by `scripts/render-legal-html.py`.

## Live URLs

- Terms: https://phantomorganization.github.io/proxy-legal/terms/
- Privacy: https://phantomorganization.github.io/proxy-legal/privacy/

When `proxy.ai` DNS is ready, serve the same files at `/terms` and `/privacy` and update `LEGAL_URLS` in the app.
